description: This file defines classes for handling 'updates' commands in Kickstart scripts, including parsing and string representation, with support for different versions (F7 and F34).

classes.name: F7_Updates
classes.description: Handles 'updates' command for Fedora 7 version, including parsing arguments and generating command string.

classes.name: F34_Updates
classes.description: Handles 'updates' command for Fedora 34 version, extending F7_Updates with version-specific parser and string output.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the updates command object with optional URL and parser setup.

methods.name: __str__
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the command, including the URL if set.

methods.name: _getParser
methods.description: Creates and returns an argument parser for the updates command, with version-specific options.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to set the URL or handle errors.

methods.name: set_to_self
methods.description: Sets parsed arguments to object attributes (used in F34_Updates).
